content.title: Content creation foundations
content.intro: Useful content gives a specific audience a clear reason to watch, read, save, or share.

sections.title: Know who it is for
sections.body: A focused audience makes the idea easier to shape. Start with a real question, need, or interest instead of trying to speak to everyone.

sections.title: Make one clear promise
sections.body: Strong content tells the audience what they will learn, feel, or be able to do, then delivers that value in a suitable format.

next.title: Check content creation foundations
next.body: Choose the response that best applies the foundation you just learned.

questions.prompt: Which is the strongest starting point for a new piece of content?
options: A trend everyone else is copying
A clear audience question you can answer well
A format with no defined purpose
questions.explanation: A real audience question provides both relevance and a clear promise for the content.

completion.title: You understand content creation foundations!
completion.body: You learned how audience, purpose, format, and a clear promise shape useful content.
